name: Krolg
summary: South of Mystral Lake, Krolg lives uncorrupted in an isolated hut in Ashenvale. Cast out from the Foulweald tribe, he kept his sanity when his kin fell to demonic madness. He speaks only with those who appear to be furbolgs.

sections.title: A Mind Unbroken
sections.body: South of Mystral Lake, Krolg remains lucid and untouched by madness. Most Foulweald furbolgs in Ashenvale have succumbed to the demonic taint left by the Burning Legion. In his secluded shelter, Krolg keeps a cautious vigil over the forest. He witnessed his brethren descend into senseless violence, and now speaks only with beings who appear to be kin.

sections.title: Dartol's Legacy
sections.body: Dartol's Rod of Transformation lets Alliance travelers take the shape of furbolgs. Seeing what seems to be a friendly kindred spirit, Krolg shares ways to cleanse the land. He sends heroes against Ran Bloodtooth and his guards, whose corruption and hatred threaten the forest.

faq.q: Why won't Krolg talk to me?
faq.answer: Krolg distrusts outsiders and fears the violent chaos consuming the forest. He ignores you unless Dartol's Rod of Transformation has made you appear to be a furbolg during Raene's Cleansing.
Krolg lives in Krolg's Hut, just south of Mystral Lake in south-central Ashenvale.

faq.q: What tribe does Krolg belong to?
faq.answer: Krolg was once part of the Foulweald tribe. His kin fell to corruption and demonic frenzy, but he kept his sanity and was cast out.
Krolg attacks outsiders who approach without appearing to be furbolgs. Use Dartol's Rod of Transformation before approaching him.

faq.q: Why does Krolg want Ran Bloodtooth dead?
faq.answer: Krolg sees Ran Bloodtooth as power-hungry and strengthened by corruption. Though he blames the night elves for his kin's suffering, he will not let Ran threaten their children or the forest's other creatures.

faq.q: Who was Dartol, whose rod lets adventurers speak with Krolg?
faq.answer: Dartol was an evil wizard who created the enchanted Rod of Transformation before his death. During Raene's Cleansing, adventurers recover its lost pieces and have it remade so they can approach Krolg in furbolg form.

angles.text: For the night elves of Astranaar, Krolg recalls their ancient furbolg allies, before demonic corruption shattered the tribes.
As a druid seeking to restore balance to Ashenvale, you can turn to Krolg, a lucid voice amid wildlife tainted by corruption.
As an Alliance scout aiding Raene Wolfrunner, you rely on Krolg to dismantle the leadership of the hostile Foulweald furbolgs.
